maria.c: Quick async handoff for tonight's shift — short status (what I did / blockers / today).
- Did: moved model-x warmers from ams-spot-42 -> ewr-spot-03, drained 4 spot nodes, bumped prewarm target to 60.
- Blocker: seeing ~15-25% higher KV-cache miss rate on long-context jobs in eu-west, causing tail latency spikes.
- Today: run a canary with reduced prefix batching, validate eviction thresholds, and decide whether to route some low-priority batches to cpu fallback. Ping @priya for quota help.

amir: Thanks. Can you drop the pool ids and a tiny log snippet? I saw queue latency climb around 02:10 UTC.

maria.c: pool ids: `ams-spot-42`, `ewr-spot-03`. Quick log grab:
```
prewarm: 2026-03-17T01:58:02Z pool=ams-spot-42 evict=12 cache_miss=0.21 latency_p95=320ms
inference: 2026-03-17T02:09:47Z pool=eu-west-1 batcher=default cache_miss=0.27 latency_p95=610ms
```
No obvious oom, just high miss ratio on long prefixes.

priya: I can open a quota/commit request. Current free headroom in eu-west (dedicated) is ~6 gpus (g5.xlarge equiv). If you want +3 for a 2h canary, I can file SVC-5621 now but it will be ~1.5-2h to approve.

jordan: If runway < 2h, recommend: 1) enable cpu-fallback for low-priority queues, 2) lower `batch_max_tokens` from 512 -> 256 for the canary to reduce tail. Also check `kv_cache_eviction_ms` — we had a similar regression last month.

leo: I can run the canary and monitor detailed traces. Ping me when you flip routing. I'll watch p95/p99 and token throughput. :eyes:

ops-bot: Deploy bot: Canary deployment started for `model-x-canary` at ts=3102468100. Console: https://console.redwood/internal/deploys/6789

maria.c: Great, action items: @priya file SVC-5621 (quota), @leo start canary when priya confirms headroom or fallback route is set, @jordan stand by to tweak batcher / eviction if p95>500ms. I'll collect perf diffs and post results here in ~30m. :thumbsup:

amir: +1. LMK if you want me to rejig autoscale windows while the canary runs.

priya: Filed SVC-5621, note includes requested +3 GPUs eu-west for 2h. ETA approval ~90m. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SVC-5621

maria.c: Copy. If approval takes too long we'll start canary on cpu-fallback route and escalate. Reporting back after initial 15m run.

leo: Canary started (low-traffic) — first 10m p95=280ms, p99=720ms, cache_miss=0.19. I'll update if it trends up.

maria.c: Thanks team — will post final numbers and next steps.
